critical.issue: Returns 502 'Payment provider error: metadata.scheduled_at Input should be a valid string [input=None]'. Root cause: /app/backend/payments_service.py:95 sets metadata['scheduled_at'] = booking['scheduled_at'] which is None when no scheduled_at was provided by the client, but emergentintegrations CheckoutSessionRequest.metadata requires string values. Iteration 17 review explicitly expected this call to return 200. Fix: skip inserting metadata['scheduled_at'] when booking['scheduled_at'] is None, or coerce to '' or ISO string.

action_items: Fix coaching_session checkout when scheduled_at is None: in /app/backend/payments_service.py:93-95 only set metadata['scheduled_at'] if booking.get('scheduled_at') is not None (currently unconditionally assigns None → Stripe request pydantic validation fails 502). Alternatively coerce to empty string. Iteration 17 review requires this to return 200.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/payments_service.py: metadata dict receives None value for 'scheduled_at' when the booking has no scheduled time — should either omit the key or coerce to string. This is a real regression affecting the coaching Book & Pay flow whenever the user has not chosen a slot (calendar-style flow always sets one, but any callsite that doesn't will 502).
/app/backend/server.py:397: db.users.find_one by apple_sub does not project out _id — but returns via public_user() so OK. Confirm public_user() strips _id (spot-check recommended).
/app/backend/server.py Apple JWKS cache is a module-level dict — safe for a single worker but would need per-process locking for multi-worker deploys. Non-blocking for now.
/app/frontend/app/index.tsx AppleSignInButton correctly guards with Platform.OS !== 'ios' and isAvailableAsync() so it renders nothing on web/Android. Verified in Playwright.

rca_of_issue: Coaching-checkout 502 RCA: pay_create_booking in payments_service.py returns {'scheduled_at': None} when the client omits scheduled_at. create_checkout_session then does metadata['scheduled_at'] = booking['scheduled_at']. The emergentintegrations CheckoutSessionRequest pydantic model declares metadata as Dict[str, str] (all values must be strings, non-null). Pydantic raises 'Input should be a valid string [input=None]' → caught by server.py:824 which wraps it as 502 'Payment provider error: …'. Mitigation: `if booking.get('scheduled_at'): metadata['scheduled_at'] = booking['scheduled_at']` on payments_service.py:95, OR coerce with str(booking.get('scheduled_at') or '').
